# Om Communication Work (OCW)

> Professional security systems, telecommunications, biometric access control, and structured networking infrastructure provider based in Delhi-NCR, India.

## Company Summary
- **Organization Name**: Om Communication Work (OCW)
- **Year Established**: 2009
- **Experience**: 15+ Years of Turnkey Project Execution
- **Geographic Service Area**: Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad (National Capital Region, India)
- **Primary Business Focus**: Turnkey electronic security system design, supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
- **Phone**: +91 72177 15296 / +91 88029 80922
- **Website**: https://om-communication-portal.hiteshdheer155.workers.dev

## Core Engineering Services
1. **CCTV Surveillance Systems**: IP cameras, high-definition analog CCTV, Network Video Recorders (NVR), Digital Video Recorders (DVR), centralized security monitoring control rooms, color night vision, motion detection analytics, and remote mobile viewing.
2. **EPABX & Office Intercom Systems**: Multi-line PBX systems, digital/IP intercom networks, vertical riser shaft cabling, Krone distribution frames, auto-attendant, extension routing, and gate-to-flat residential communication.
3. **Video Door Phone (VDP) & Intercom**: Multi-apartment and standalone villa video entry panels, indoor color touch monitors, electronic rim lock integration, two-way audio verification, and visitor snapshot capture.
4. **Biometric Attendance & Access Control**: Fingerprint terminals, AI face recognition access readers, RFID proximity card readers, electromagnetic door strikes, shift-based attendance logging, and zone-based entry management.
5. **Structured Cabling & Networking Infrastructure**: CAT6/CAT6A copper cabling, server rack assembly, patch panel dressing & termination, Gigabit PoE switches, ISI-marked PVC/GI conduit raceways, and LAN speed certification.
6. **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)**: Comprehensive and non-comprehensive maintenance agreements, scheduled preventive system audits, priority technician dispatch, lens cleaning, PSU testing, and backup power checks.
